M-PROPERTY-WEAVER.Purpose: Fody weaver that redirects annotated auto-properties onto implementations generated by M-WIDGET-EMITTER and M-FLEXVERSE-PROPERTY, rewriting IL with Mono.Cecil after compilation.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: ModuleWeaver: locate annotated auto-properties, rewrite getter/setter bodies to call generated counterparts.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Failure modes: missing generated counterpart, missing FlexVerse reference. Source emission — owned by M-WIDGET-EMITTER.

Requirements.REQ-001: Every annotated auto-property getter/setter calls its generated _Get{Prop}/_Set{Prop} implementation per S-METAPROGRAMMING.REQ-003.
Requirements.REQ-002: A missing generated counterpart fails the build with an explicit weaver error per SS-IL-WEAVING.REQ-001.
Requirements.REQ-003: When the FlexVerse.Widget type cannot be resolved, the weaver aborts with an explicit error and weaves nothing.
Requirements.REQ-004: Properties without the annotation are left untouched even when their type is a Behavior.

Outputs.OUT-001: rewritten assembly with redirected property accessors.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Modifies the compiled module in place during the Fody build step.

M-PROPERTY-WEAVER.Codemap: * `ModuleWeaver` : Fody `ModuleWeaver` * `ModuleWeaver.Execute` -> `Widget.{Prop}` getter => `Widget._Get{Prop}` * `ModuleWeaver.Execute` -> `Widget.{Prop}` setter => `Widget._Set{Prop}` * `ModuleWeaver.Execute` -> `[FVP].{Prop}` => `_Get{Prop}` | `_Set{Prop}` (M-FLEXVERSE-PROPERTY) * `FvpAttribute` + `{PropAttribute|StateAttribute|InheritedContextAttribute}` => `IsTarget` * missing counterpart => build error
